source: Meetup city search, rounds 11-13 (60 cities: Long Island and NJ/PA suburbs, western secondary cities, northern New England and upper Midwest)
note: Four listings. Rounds 11 and 12 were first run concurrently with the rounds 8-10 write-up and re-surfaced groups that write-up had just claimed; they were re-run afterwards so the cross-batch dedupe could see it, which cut round 11 from 11 candidates to 4 and round 12 from 7 to 1. Round 13's twenty northern New England and upper Midwest cities produced nothing listable, matching round 6.

excluded.event: Hong Kong Mahjong, Burlington ONTARIO — Friday and Tuesday afternoons weekly, Wednesday evenings
excluded.reason: A genuine find and a rare one — three weekly HONG KONG style sessions — but in Burlington, Ontario, CANADA. It surfaced from the us--vt--Burlington search. The site cannot represent it: US_STATES in src/lib/constants.ts holds the fifty states and DC and nothing else, so a listing with state "ON" would render its state as the bare code, generate no state page, and drop out of the state-based navigation and sitemap. Supporting Canada is a product decision that touches state pages, SEO and the sitemap, not something to slip in through a listing. Recorded here in full so it can be imported the day provinces are supported.

listings.notes: Discovered 2026-08-31 via Meetup city search of Cherry Hill. One posted date, no series, so it is a dated event.
